reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and $49-59 a month is a real bill for something I might use a few times. The playground and library are free, so this feels like a nice-to-have.
objection: I can't tell how clean it is or how often they sanitize the toys. And I'd be locked into a monthly cost I can't really afford right now.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap or free trial visit where I can see the cleaning routine, plus drop-in at about $6-8 with no membership, so I only pay when I go.
